rationale: The change adds new admin endpoints and approval workflow behavior around affiliate product drafts. Risk is reduced by keeping Phase 1 approval-only, avoiding schema changes, removing direct publish routing, and passing focused tests/type-checks.

factors.name: Admin endpoint surface
factors.notes: New trend signal and product draft endpoints are protected by AdminApiKeyGuard.

factors.name: Publishing safety
factors.notes: Direct publish route is absent and service publishing fails closed.

factors.name: Data persistence
factors.notes: Existing models are used; no Prisma schema or migration change.

factors.name: Frontend operations
factors.notes: Existing dashboard page now drives approval-only actions with idempotency keys.

factors.name: Validation coverage
factors.notes: Focused Affiliate AI OS tests, API type-check, web type-check, and diff whitespace check passed.

requiredMitigations: Keep no-auto-publishing invariant until an explicit publish phase ships.
Review admin API authorization before exposing to production operators.
Monitor approval audit events after deploy.
